name: L. M. Dustin
role: Miles City Dressed Beef Co. (Hough & Dustin)
mentions: …n the works. The outstanding accounts in Montana aggregate about $95,000 and the backer of the concern, L. M. Dustin of Lincoln, Ill., is a financial wreck. His bank at Lincoln is also closed, owing to a run on it. In what ever light this matter is placed it cannot but be a misforture…
